metadata.note: The boundary @hobo/trails consumes without importing this package: the dual-run port. Trails declares the port structurally and this package satisfies it. The load-bearing rule is the first interaction — the oracle is given counts and digests, never rows — and the second: a write for a fenced tenant is refused, which is what keeps exactly one write authority during a pooled-to-silo move. test/data-dual-port.test.ts replays every interaction against two real SQLite files.
